name: orquesta
description: A single vibe-coding system for people who don't program. You talk to one orchestrator in plain language; it guides you through vision, features, logic, experience and implementation, lets you pick the look of your app from three visual directions by a designer (warm, editorial house style), then delegates to a technical architect, frontend and backend builders and a reviewer. A test lead with four testers evaluates every phase against your specs, and built-in project memory reaches every agent.
